fields.summary: TC-748-01: First and Last Flight Time Fields Populated in CSS DB Analytics Schema After Trip Processing

content.text: Linked Story: CREWCMBR-748

Precondition: A trip with multiple legs is processed by the COA Step Function. The CSS DB Analytics Schema must be updated with coaTripFirstFltDtm, coaTripLastFltDtm, coaDpFirstFltDtm, and coaDpLastFltDtm fields.
TEST STEPS
Step
Action
Test Data
Expected Result
Set up a trip with 2 DPs and multiple legs with distinct first and last flight departure/arrival datetimes
Trip: DP1 legs (DAL->HOU dep 06:00Z, HOU->AUS dep 09:00Z). DP2 legs (AUS->LAX dep 13:00Z, LAX->PHX dep 17:00Z arr 19:00Z)
Trip data is ready for processing by the COA Step Function
Trigger the COA Step Function to process the trip
COA Step Function crew-qa2-techp-cmn-coa-lineholder with full trip payload
Step Function completes successfully and updates the COA record in DynamoDB
Verify coaTripFirstFltDtm and coaTripLastFltDtm are populated in the CSS DB Analytics Schema
Expected: coaTripFirstFltDtm = 2026-03-03T06:00:00Z (first leg dep), coaTripLastFltDtm = 2026-03-03T19:00:00Z (last leg arr)
coaTripFirstFltDtm = departure of first leg across entire trip. coaTripLastFltDtm = arrival of last leg across entire trip
Verify coaDpFirstFltDtm and coaDpLastFltDtm are populated per Duty Period in the Analytics Schema
DP1: coaDpFirstFltDtm=06:00Z, coaDpLastFltDtm=09:xx (arr of HOU->AUS). DP2: coaDpFirstFltDtm=13:00Z, coaDpLastFltDtm=19:00Z
coaDpFirstFltDtm and coaDpLastFltDtm are correctly set per DP based on each DP's first leg departure and last leg arrival
Verify the Analytics Schema endpoint exposes these fields correctly for auditor consumption
Analytical Schema endpoint queried for the trip record
Analytical Schema response contains coaTripFirstFltDtm, coaTripLastFltDtm, coaDpFirstFltDtm, coaDpLastFltDtm with correct values
